pattern: join on id, compute per-row delta, average by group
question: for each centre how much did the shuttle sprint time change on average between the two tests
gold_sql: SELECT b."Location", AVG(e."Shuttle Run sec" - b."Shuttle Run sec") AS avg_shuttle_change FROM sportathon_baseline AS b JOIN sportathon_endline AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY b."Location" ORDER BY b."Location"
sql_duckdb: SELECT baseline."Location", AVG(endline."Shuttle Run sec" - baseline."Shuttle Run sec") AS avg_shuttle_run_change FROM sportathon_baseline AS baseline JOIN sportathon_endline AS endline ON baseline."Child ID" = endline."Child ID" GROUP BY baseline."Location"

    AVG(endline."Shuttle Run sec" - baseline."Shuttle Run sec") AS avg_shuttle_run_change
